modelDescription: Savage Arms AXIS XP offers reliable performance and exceptional accuracy out of the box, all at an affordable price. Features include silky smooth bolt operation, the New AXIS synthetic stock, detachable box magazine and factory-mounted, bore-sighted Weaver® 3-9x40mm scope. The 22-inch carbon barrel sports a matte blued finish. At just 6.5 pounds, the AXIS XP reflects a modern design highlighted by sleek contours, recoil pad vents and a textured, easy-to-control grip.
